address.note: The tutor sees only the area until she confirms. The street address is shared afterwards.

empty.title: No bookings yet
empty.body: When you request a tutor, the engagement appears here.

list.emptyBody: When you request a tutor, the engagement appears here with its state and what happens next.
list.tutorEmptyBody: Requests from families appear here. Answering quickly matters — a family that waits books somebody else.

request.title: Request a booking
request.studentHint: Add your child here. Children do not have accounts on Ustaad.com — you hold the account and arrange everything through it.
request.modeAny: Any of the ways she teaches
request.addressHint: House and street. Read what the tutor will and will not see, below.
request.slotTaken: That time was booked by somebody else while you were filling this in. The times below have been refreshed — please choose another.

slots.onlyFreeNote: Only times the tutor is actually free are shown. A time already booked does not appear here at all, so nothing you can choose can be refused for being taken.
slots.emptyTitle: No free times in the next two weeks
slots.emptyBody: She may have no availability set, or everything may be booked. You can still ask on the unmet demand board.

single.heading: What this hour is for
single.whyRequired: Both of these are required. They are what lets the tutor arrive prepared — it is the difference between a useful hour and an hour spent working out why you came.

purpose.concept_clarification: A concept that is not going in
purpose.assessment_review: Going over a test or assignment

single.topicsHint: Choose at least one. The tutor prepares from this.
single.noTopics: This tutor has not listed topics for the chosen subject yet.

monthly.cycleWeeksHint: Usually four. A payment record is raised per cycle.

disclosure.heading: Who sees the address

family.beforeConfirm: Before she confirms, the tutor sees only your area — not your street or house number.
family.afterConfirm: After she confirms, she sees the full address, because she has to get there.
family.nowVisible: She has confirmed, so she can now see the full address.

tutor.beforeConfirm: Until you confirm, you see the area only. That is enough to decide whether you are willing to travel there.
tutor.afterConfirm: Once you confirm, you see the full address.
tutor.nowVisible: You have confirmed, so the full address is available to you.

disclosure.nobodyElse: Nobody else ever sees it. It is not on any public profile and not in any search result.

safety.heading: Conditions this tutor has set
safety.guardianRequired: She teaches only with a parent or guardian present in the home.
safety.enforcedNote: Ustaad.com enforces these — a request that does not meet them is refused rather than passed on. Declines she makes under her own conditions do not count against her statistics.
safety.acknowledgeLabel: A parent or guardian will be present for every session
safety.acknowledgeHint: The request cannot be sent without this.
safety.refused: This tutor requires a guardian present. Tick the box above to continue, or choose a tutor who does not set this condition.

trial.flagHint: One session to find out whether this tutor suits your child, before committing to a month. Afterwards you will be asked a few private questions about how it went.

fit.heading: How did the trial go?
fit.privateNotice: The tutor never sees this. Not the scores, not your comments, not whether you filled it in. It is not shown on her profile, does not affect her ranking, and is not included in any statistic about her. Please answer honestly — that is the only reason this is worth asking.

dimensionHint.communication: Could your child follow her explanations and ask questions?
dimensionHint.punctuality: Did she arrive when she said she would?
dimensionHint.engagement: Was your child involved, or sitting through it?
dimensionHint.pace: Too fast, too slow, or about right?

fit.continueLegend: Would you continue with this tutor?
fit.noteHint: Optional. Write in whatever language you like — it is stored exactly as you write it.

lifecycle.heading: What happens next
lifecycle.noActions: This booking is finished. Nothing further can be changed on it.

terminal.completed: This engagement is complete. Completed bookings are not reopened — reviews, payment records and the progress ledger all hang off them.

lifecycle.reasonRequired: A reason is required, and the other party will see it. A booking that disappears without explanation is worse than one that is declined clearly.
lifecycle.underSafetyConstraintLabel: I am declining because of a condition I declared
lifecycle.underSafetyConstraintHint: Declines made under your own declared conditions are excluded from your confirmation rate. Tick this now — it cannot be added afterwards.
